<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="armoured-phantoms" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Armoured Phantoms</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Armoured phantoms are the highest tiered Zemouregal's undead, requiring 113 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to kill. Even though their drops are worth less than that of other similar high-levelled slayer monsters such as abyssal lords </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1" alt="abyssallord" title="abyssallord" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and moss golems </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107335343542404.png?v=1" alt="mossgolem" title="mossgolem" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, they offer competitive XP rates and make for a fairly speedy task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>They can be killed for following tasks:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Armoured phantoms, assigned by </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The Raptor</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Laniakea</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zemouregal's undead, assigned by </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The Raptor</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead cluster, assigned by </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The Raptor</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Laniakea</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 2625 + 866.2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 2500</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~900 (~800 AFK </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~630 AFK </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~2.2M (~2M AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These rates do not include other factors such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1" alt="slayercodex" title="slayercodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1" alt="sacrificescrim" title="sacrificescrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1114819109650169896.png?v=1" alt="bonefragments" title="bonefragments" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or other XP boosts.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Sonic_Wave_ability_codex <nowiki>Greater Sonic Wave ability codex</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411830207299654.png?v=1" alt="gsoniccodex" title="gsoniccodex" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 times rarer off-task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Often killed for very high XP rates.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="afk-methods"><ins><nowiki>AFK Methods</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ AFK relies on only allowing </nowiki><strong><nowiki>one</nowiki></strong><nowiki> phantom to attack you at once by either:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Standing in a corner, causing phantoms to pile up to be hit with AoE damage such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1" alt="magmatempest" title="magmatempest" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe3" title="spectralscythe3" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Platypus <nowiki>platypus</nowiki>]<nowiki> or </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Tooth_creature <nowiki>tooth creature</nowiki>]<nowiki> pet to block phantoms. A cannon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with the Restocking Cannon upgrade is not necessary for this, but increases kph. An aggression potion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used instead, but yields less kph.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="positioning"><nowiki>Positioning</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Place the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1" alt="kineticcyclone" title="kineticcyclone" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for west spot) and:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee: Position yourself in the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>west</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as shown below, with the blocking pet to your </nowiki><strong><nowiki>south</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (player position in red):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Else: Position yourself in the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>north-eastern corner</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (shown as </nowiki><em><nowiki>Other</nowiki></em><nowiki> in purple):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>^^</nowiki><em><nowiki>Watching the lure example is recommended!</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>^^</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Mc4A2cAsS4.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sticky bombs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1" alt="stickybomb" title="stickybomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be thrown at healing phantom spirits to despawn them when setting up</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="rod" title="rod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (recommended for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1" alt="reaverring" title="reaverring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are both good with 100% hit chance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every 25 minutes, the cannon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> needs to be refreshed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Platypus and tooth creature do not need to be fed. They will not run away, even as babies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ability-bars"><nowiki>Ability Bars</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="active-method"><ins><nowiki>Active Method </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure the following things are active when using this method:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deflect melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Turmoil/Malevolence </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="malevolence" title="malevolence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Elder overload </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and aggression potion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hellhound familiar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Revo++ and auto-retaliate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1" alt="autoretaliate" title="autoretaliate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> enabled.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kinetic cyclone </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1" alt="kineticcyclone" title="kineticcyclone" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Scrimshaw of Vampyrism </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1" alt="vampscrim" title="vampscrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> switched on.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Armoured phantoms can be AoE'd efficiently using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Stand in the middle of your cannon as shown below so that the cannon can hit any phantom which approaches you.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You are positioned nearer to the back of the room to avoid risen ghost aggression.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/m6pc0AxrzQ.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ This method requires a consistently high damage output to minimise specs. The general ability outline is as follows:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prioritise AoE </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1" alt="cleave" title="cleave" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, squeeze in some </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1" alt="dragonhalberd" title="dragonhalberd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if there's sufficient adrenaline.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1" alt="zgs" title="zgs" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ends.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1" alt="zgs" title="zgs" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1" alt="dragonhalberd" title="dragonhalberd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> depending on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1279516151423963166.png?v=1" alt="critbuff" title="critbuff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> procs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try to get as many </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> resets as possible when building adrenaline.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when HP falls below ~20%, sip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690140078407680059.png?v=1" alt="supergrest" title="supergrest" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Try to have </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> key bound somewhere in that order so you can spec and switch back to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> easily by pressing 3 side-by-side keys.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1" alt="stickybomb" title="stickybomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to negate any healing orbs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Remember to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1" alt="prismofrestoration" title="prismofrestoration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to restore </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
